ns2:section.sectionText: Graduate Seminar in Evolution. Title: Evolution of Mechanical Systems. This seminar will explore the emerging field of evolutionary biomechanics focusing on how researchers are integrating evolutionary theory with our understanding of the physical influences on morphology. Students will prepare a bibliography, give a five minute introduction, and lead discussion on a recent paper or topic chosen from suggestions provided by the instructor. The instructor will give initial presentations on formative theoretical papers in evolutionary biomechanics as needed to provide background for preparation of student presentations. WILL MEET IN THE VIVARIUM CONFERENCE ROOM.
